explanation: The Almighty Creator who is central in the story of justice, prayer, and humility.
An official with authority to decide cases; here used as a contrast figure for God's justice.
A woman whose husband has died, often in a vulnerable economic situation and a symbol of the outcast.
The quality of acting rightly or giving each their due; here linked to God's will to do right by his believers.
Members of a strict Jewish religious group who often relied on their own piety and obedience to the law.
A tax collector employed by the Romans, looked down upon by Jews because they collaborated with the occupying power.
The quality of being modest and not having an inflated self-image; the key to justice in Jesus' eyes.
To be declared innocent or righteous by God, based on faith rather than one's own works.
